name: Peppe
personality: Formal, royal-'we'-speaking noble who is grateful to Ultand.
story: Peppe is a Brigid noble who came to Dagsion in 1449 to study Dagdan culture and owes Ultand for help there. He loves hunting, the sun and his homeland. He is recruitable on Cai, Dietrich and Theodora's routes after clearing Bertrand's Paralogue, and cannot be recruited on Leda's route.

personalSkill.name: Hunter's Snare
personalSkill.effect: In enemy phase, if foe is damaged, unit attacks first (trigger 30%). Lv20: King's Majesty (Atk+2, Crit+5 vs damaged foes). Lv35: King's Majesty+ (Atk+4, Crit+10 vs damaged foes).

tierNotes: KeenGamer: C tier (late arrival 7/1, low HP/Str; most useful on Theodora's route). Pocket Tactics: B tier.

why: Lowest Support requirement of any route: 1 here vs Dietrich 3, Theodora 2.
recruit.tip: Needs Bertrand's Paralogue, which Cai gets for 9 days (9/17–9/25). Dietrich only gets 9/17.

path: Rogue? (joins at Lv 25 in Ch 10 or 11; bench in Part I)
build.part1Target: Bench (joins in a Specialty class, Rogue?): recruit for Part II
build.notes: Joins in Ch 10 or 11 at about Lv 25, already in a Specialty class; benched in Part I. Arena Bow B and Sword B. Part II: Army Training to Lv 34 in Rogue (In Shadow), Ranger from Ch 3 (Countershot). Shadow Seeker in Part III.

guide.summary: Benched in Part I: he joins in Ch 10 or 11 at about Lv 25, already in a Specialty class, with two or three maps left and Peter covering bows. Spd grows 75% in Rogue and Ranger, and Hunter's Snare and King's Majesty reward hitting foes that are already hurt. Rogue through Part II Ch 2, Ranger from Ch 3.
guide.playstyle: Finish wounded foes with Destreza or bow arts; enemy-phase bait only against slow units. HP and Str grow 30 to 40%: don't let him take two hits.
keys: Clear Bertrand's Paralogue (9/17 to 9/25) to recruit him.
Bench: Arena Infantry Training every week for Bow B and Sword B.
Equip the Tempest Bow, Horsekiller Bow and Cleansing Blade at the end of Ch 12.
Joins as a Specialty unit (Rogue?): In Shadow on the bench and in Part II Ch 1 to 2; Ranger (Countershot) from Ch 3.
watch: Low HP and Str: finisher, not frontliner.
Only about 8 Arena weeks before Part II: if Bow or Sword is short of B, he stays Rogue.
Weight: Part II Tempest Bow 5 + Gale Ring 2 = 7. Part III Da Mina Bow +2 6 + 2 = 8, Cleansing Blade +2 3 + 2 = 5; Horsekiller Bow +2 8 + 2 = 10 on cavalry turns only. Extra stays at 2.
Inventory: 5 into Part II (Tempest Bow, Horsekiller Bow, Cleansing Blade, Gale Ring, Concoction), 1 open.

stages.when: Join (Ch 10 or 11) to Part II Ch 2
stages.goal: Bench, then Rogue in Part II: Spd 75 growth and In Shadow.
stages.exit: Ranger in Part II Ch 3 (Bow B, Sword B), with or without In Shadow mastered

training.how: Arena Infantry Training (Sword, Bow, Infantry) covers both; he has about 8 weeks (Ch 10 to 12); Rogue also trains both

tips: Joins at about Lv 25 already in a Specialty class (which one is ?). Not Rogue? Take its exam (Bow C, Sword C) on a Specialty License.
Recruit cost: Renown 9, clear Bertrand's Paralogue (9/17 to 9/25).
Talimun's Paralogue Cleansing Blade still goes to him for Part II.
Skip heavy accessories: weight costs his doubles
No free time in Part II: only equipped items come in, so equip them at the end of Ch 12
